items.summary: 消费动态 鱼你在一起第七代小碗菜模型全球旗舰店亮相北京合生汇 11月27日，鱼你在一起第七代（以下简称7.0）小碗菜模型全球旗舰店在北京朝阳合生汇亮相。区别于普通新店开业，这是品牌从“酸菜鱼快餐”走向“复合米饭快餐”后，正式把新模型放进高势能商圈实战场，标志着7.0小碗菜模型迈入规模化复制验证期。此次旗舰店位于合生汇B1层，面积约180㎡，百余个餐位，十多米自选动线串起鲜货区、蒸笼区和小炒明档。
items.content:
鱼你在一起第七代小碗菜模型全球旗舰店亮相北京合生汇

11月27日，鱼你在一起第七代（以下简称7.0）小碗菜模型全球旗舰店在北京朝阳合生汇亮相。区别于普通新店开业，这是品牌从“酸菜鱼快餐”走向“复合米饭快餐”后，正式把新模型放进高势能商圈实战场，标志着7.0小碗菜模型迈入规模化复制验证期。此次旗舰店位于合生汇B1层，面积约180㎡，百余个餐位，十多米自选动线串起鲜货区、蒸笼区和小炒明档。据了解，鱼你在一起全球在营门店超2700家，今年9月7.0小碗菜模型首个试点在北京全球总店落地，凭借“当家酸菜鱼，百味小碗菜”全新结构引发行业关注。

7.0小碗菜模型是用“一鱼为本、蒸炒两翼”将过去的平面菜单立体化，突破传统米饭快餐在客群和经营时段上的天花板：酸菜鱼奠定品牌认知，浏阳蒸菜做高频下饭，湖南土菜小炒提供聚餐理由，一人食、工作餐、家庭餐等场景都能顺利承接，并向全时段延展。效率上，标准化设备使高峰期得以集中批量出餐，不依赖大厨，大幅节省人效；明档小份自选，取餐、结账、就餐动线流畅，同一时段承接和转化更多客流。同时，依托品牌成熟的供应链体系，全国乃至全球食材汇集一店，超40款菜品，为高频复购提供坚实支撑。极致运营、极致效率、极致供应链，构成承接商场高客流的底盘。此外，品牌还同步提出了“存量改造”路径：现有门店会逐步完成系统性升级，逐步增加蒸菜、小炒等产品线，平滑升级为复合型米饭快餐模型。12月即将开业的北京亦庄龙湖天街店，以及正在陆续落位的数十家新店，将进一步验证7.0小碗菜模型跨区域稳定性与普适性。

波司登发布的截至2026年9月30日止六个月中期业绩显示，收入91.03亿元，同比增加2%；公司权益股东应占溢利12.42亿元，同比上升4.5%。羽绒服业务表现稳健。报告期内，羽绒服收入66.6亿元，占总收入73.1%，同比上升1.4%；羽绒服业务利润13.65亿元，同比增加2.3%，对应溢利率约20.5%。其中主品牌波司登收入57.3亿元，同比基本持平；雪中飞4.13亿元，同比上升9.1%；冰洁收入约600万元，同比下降60.6%。增量更多来自子品牌与线上。渠道层面，波司登持续优化门店结构，截至9月末，羽绒服业务常规零售网点3502家，同比净减少145家；女装零售网点283家，净减少22家。库存周转天数同比减少13天。全品牌线上销售收入15.88亿元，同比上升11.3%。

元气森林公布业务表现，2026年外星人与好自在实现双位数增长

11 月 20 日，元气森林 2026 年全国经销商大会在广东珠海举行。会上披露，外星人电解质水与好自在 2026 年均实现双位数增长。据马上赢和前瞻产业研究院数据，两个品类 2025 年的份额基数分别为 46.5%和 50.8%。在高基数上继续增长，靠的不是短期促销，而是持续数年的产品投入与体系能力建设。在经销商大会上，创始人唐彬森及相关负责人先后上台，围绕产品、渠道和伙伴关系分享了公司的经营思考。唐彬森用“做减法，实现增长”概括今年的变化：今年是元气森林在售品项最少的一年，库存状况也是近年最好，新品先小范围测试，下半年才陆续推出。减法不是不创新，而是把创新的命中率抬上去。老品守基本盘、新品拿增量、限定款做测试，成为大会传递出的产品经营思路。品牌产品负责人张壬坤介绍了2027年的品牌矩阵与产品规划，她表示，公司将继续在核心品类上保持投入。外星人电解质水升级主力款的口感与配方，并向更权威专业的运动营养场景延伸；好自在以“好标准、好食材、好工艺”深化产区共建；冰茶面向既有用户基础做深做透；满分维C水拓展产品线；新品企鹅吨吨冰鲜柠檬水，未来将以更多水果为原料开发新口味。

始祖鸟2026雪季以「SPEAK IN TURNS」为题正式开启

11月25日，ARC'TERYX始祖鸟2026雪季启幕活动于上海西岸漩心正式拉开帷幕。本次活动以「SPEAK IN TURNS」为主题，通过品牌档案展览、雪线家族新品发布以及运动员影片首映，系统呈现了品牌在滑雪领域的专业积淀与持续探索。活动现场特邀始祖鸟运动员张嘉豪、杨小华，与知名主持人水均益开启「热爱永续」主题对谈沙龙，共同探讨身份的转变与不变的热爱。始祖鸟通过打造贯穿品牌雪服历史的档案展览，呈现其深耕滑雪领域的专业积淀。自2001年推出首款采用弧形拉链设计的滑雪装备Sidewinder硬壳夹克以来，该系列历经二十余年持续进化，本季迎来回归。作为贯穿展览叙事与本次发布的核心产品，Sidewinder响尾蛇作为大师级经典装备亮相展区。从经典单品延伸至完整的场景矩阵，雪线家族展区按三大核心滑雪场景划分独立展示区域：道内滑雪系列（MACAI / ANDESSA / FISSILE）聚焦滑行与缆车驻留间的精准控温与从容切换；登山滑雪系列（RUSH）以轻量化设计与多场景诉求，回应攀登与滑降的双重挑战；高山自由滑雪系列（SIDEWINDER / SABRE / STRATO / SENTINEL）则以硬核防护与灵活剪裁，直面严冬气候与复杂地形。

迪卡侬旗下专业高山攀登品牌「SIMOND」焕新亮相中国市场

11月25日，迪卡侬集团宣布旗下专业高山攀登品牌SIMOND焕新亮相中国市场，正式开启在华发展新阶段。SIMOND聚焦高山攀登、攀岩、重装多日徒步及登山滑雪四大领域，将于2027年推动多款新品在中国市场与全球同步上市，并将持续开展本地赛事及社群活动，进一步丰富中国山地运动爱好者的装备选择与运动体验。同时，迪卡侬将在40至50家具备山地运动资源和专业服务能力的门店，进一步强化SIMOND的产品销售与运动体验。产品方面，2027年，多款SIMOND新品将在中国市场与全球同步上市，包括品牌运动员Benjamin Védrines与Nicolas Jean攀登贾努东峰时使用的同款冰镐、冰爪等高山攀登技术装备；线下渠道方面，迪卡侬计划从中国大陆200余家门店中，重点布局40至50家具备攀登运动资源和专业服务能力的门店，加强SIMOND攀岩和攀登产品的陈列与体验。
paragraphs: 鱼你在一起第七代小碗菜模型全球旗舰店亮相北京合生汇

11月27日，鱼你在一起第七代（以下简称7.0）小碗菜模型全球旗舰店在北京朝阳合生汇亮相。区别于普通新店开业，这是品牌从“酸菜鱼快餐”走向“复合米饭快餐”后，正式把新模型放进高势能商圈实战场，标志着7.0小碗菜模型迈入规模化复制验证期。此次旗舰店位于合生汇B1层，面积约180㎡，百余个餐位，十多米自选动线串起鲜货区、蒸笼区和小炒明档。据了解，鱼你在一起全球在营门店超2700家，今年9月7.0小碗菜模型首个试点在北京全球总店落地，凭借“当家酸菜鱼，百味小碗菜”全新结构引发行业关注。

7.0小碗菜模型是用“一鱼为本、蒸炒两翼”将过去的平面菜单立体化，突破传统米饭快餐在客群和经营时段上的天花板：酸菜鱼奠定品牌认知，浏阳蒸菜做高频下饭，湖南土菜小炒提供聚餐理由，一人食、工作餐、家庭餐等场景都能顺利承接，并向全时段延展。效率上，标准化设备使高峰期得以集中批量出餐，不依赖大厨，大幅节省人效；明档小份自选，取餐、结账、就餐动线流畅，同一时段承接和转化更多客流。同时，依托品牌成熟的供应链体系，全国乃至全球食材汇集一店，超40款菜品，为高频复购提供坚实支撑。极致运营、极致效率、极致供应链，构成承接商场高客流的底盘。此外，品牌还同步提出了“存量改造”路径：现有门店会逐步完成系统性升级，逐步增加蒸菜、小炒等产品线，平滑升级为复合型米饭快餐模型。12月即将开业的北京亦庄龙湖天街店，以及正在陆续落位的数十家新店，将进一步验证7.0小碗菜模型跨区域稳定性与普适性。

波司登发布的截至2026年9月30日止六个月中期业绩显示，收入91.03亿元，同比增加2%；公司权益股东应占溢利12.42亿元，同比上升4.5%。羽绒服业务表现稳健。报告期内，羽绒服收入66.6亿元，占总收入73.1%，同比上升1.4%；羽绒服业务利润13.65亿元，同比增加2.3%，对应溢利率约20.5%。其中主品牌波司登收入57.3亿元，同比基本持平；雪中飞4.13亿元，同比上升9.1%；冰洁收入约600万元，同比下降60.6%。增量更多来自子品牌与线上。渠道层面，波司登持续优化门店结构，截至9月末，羽绒服业务常规零售网点3502家，同比净减少145家；女装零售网点283家，净减少22家。库存周转天数同比减少13天。全品牌线上销售收入15.88亿元，同比上升11.3%。

items.title: 【国内要闻】两岸职工福州同场竞技 项目辅导及成果转化AI大模型上线
items.summary: 中新社福州11月27日电 (叶秋云)于27日在福州市举行的第七届海峡两岸(福州)职工创新创业创造大赛主题日活动上，面向两岸职工的职工创新项目辅导及创新成果转化AI大模型正式上线。
items.content:
中新社福州11月27日电 (叶秋云)于27日在福州市举行的第七届海峡两岸(福州)职工创新创业创造大赛主题日活动上，面向两岸职工的职工创新项目辅导及创新成果转化AI大模型正式上线。

主办方称，该AI大模型将推动两岸职工的“金点子”成为可评估、可交易、受保护的创新资产。

本届大赛自5月启动，吸引两岸600余个项目团队报名，设职工四技创造组、职工就业创业组和两岸融合协作组。经多轮角逐，共评出金奖6项、银奖11项、铜奖19项，覆盖人工智能、新能源、新材料、智慧医疗等重点领域。其中，两岸融合协作组鼓励两岸创新团队各扬所长，将技术优势、实践经验与市场资源深度融入项目之中，推动创新理念在对话中碰撞，合作机遇在协作中生长。

斩获金奖的植物蛋白天然抑菌及抗氧化保鲜阻隔技术产品在农业科技与大健康产业应用项目出自两岸融合协作组。项目台湾代表陈正强在主题日活动现场表示，赛事搭起的平台让两岸职工各展所长，在项目落地中积累成果。

陈正强介绍，该项目核心是以纯天然植物蛋白原料替代化学防腐剂，搭配纳米保鲜技术，能够实现生鲜产品由冷冻转为冷藏存储，有效拉长保鲜周期、降低物流损耗与碳排放。目前这套技术已经在两岸农林渔等多个品类实现落地应用。

主题日活动上，首届福州市职工创新成果拍卖会成交鉴证颁证仪式同期举行。主办方介绍，前六届大赛累计150余个获奖项目中已有126个项目注册落地福州；历届共有207个台湾项目或团队参赛。(完)

items.title: 【量子位AI】人形机器人开发者集合！众擎开放大小脑，10亿产业级生态支持计划也来了
items.summary: 一支团队在真机上验证的成果，可以成为下一支团队继续开发的起点。
items.content:
好不容易搞出一套算法，仿真里跑得飞起，想上真机试试吧，手边压根儿没有机器人。

有的团队倒是在真机上跑通了，想找个真实场景检验一下技术成色，还得四处打听。

仔细一琢磨，你缺的东西，没准儿别人手里正好有。只是大家鲜少有机会坐到一张桌子上好好聊。

11月25日，在2026众擎全球开发者大会上，众擎机器人打算给伙伴们搭把手。

众擎创始人兼CEO赵同阳认为，人形机器人要走进千行万业，靠的是生态协同。

甭管你带来的是一段代码、一台样机，还是一款产品、一个客户，都能在众擎生态里找到眼下最需要的支持。

我们愿意把花了十年摸索出来的经验，手把手教给大家，陪着大家把平台用起来。

为了让生态真正跑起来，众擎重磅宣布将联合河南投资集团、元禾辰坤等产业链基金，为优秀生态伙伴提供产业级支持。

量产考验的是能不能把每一台机器人造好，商业化考验的则是能不能把每一个客户服务好。

Here’s what a bionic hand might reveal about the mind.

items.title: 【量子位AI】全国首批首家！商汤大装置获Token工厂智算能力最高评级
items.summary: 商汤大装置Token工厂获得中国信通院Token工厂智算能力评估“全栈服务型·领先级”评级认证
items.content:
商汤大装置Token工厂获得中国信通院Token工厂智算能力评估“全栈服务型·领先级”评级认证

11月27日，在第二十八届中国国际高新技术成果交易会（高交会）·可信Token云服务论坛上，中国信息通信研究院（以下简称“中国信通院”）正式发布Token工厂智算能力评估成果。商汤大装置Token工厂获得中国信通院Token工厂智算能力评估“全栈服务型·领先级”评级认证，成为全国首批首家通过该项能力评估的Token工厂，这也是行业内最高评级。

这不仅标志着商汤大装置Token工厂在Token规模化生产、全栈服务与高效运营等方面的综合实力获得权威认可，更有力推动了Token工厂在标准化评价与规范化发展方面迈出关键一步。

Token工厂作为AI工业化时代的核心算力与服务底座，近两年迅猛发展，但行业内尚未形成统一的能力评价标准，严重制约Token工厂产业的规范化发展与价值释放。中国信息通信研究院云计算与数字化研究所在充分调研产业实践基础上，研究构建了首个面向Token工厂主体的权威能力评估认证——“Token工厂·智算能力分级评价体系”。

该评价体系以Token工厂五层技术架构（基础设施层—模型服务层—聚合分发层—计量结算层—场景部署层）为评价主线，以“能力可量化、质量可验证、服务可承诺”为核心原则，按照建设主体属性、核心能力边界、商业模式差异分类评估，根据不同形态对应产业链不同环节，激活不同的评价维度，避免“一把尺子量所有主体”。

在具体测评上，评价围绕Token生产能力、生产能效水平、交付服务能力、智能运营能力、安全合规能力五大维度及14项测评指标，对Token工厂进行综合测评。

商汤大装置Token工厂在各项测评指标中，均表现优异，顺利通过“全栈服务型-领先级”认证，是目前Token工厂实际获得的最高等级认证。

随着大模型技术快速迭代与产业应用持续深化，AI产业正从单一模型技术竞争，迈向多模型协同、规模化Token服务的新阶段，对Token工厂的生产效率、服务交付及综合运营能力提出了更高要求。

面向这一产业趋势，商汤大装置前瞻打造Token工厂，以AI原生云平台SenseCore为核心，贯通能源、算力、平台、模型与应用，构建面向Agentic时代的高质量Token全栈生产与服务体系，实现Token稳定、高效、低成本的规模化供给。

全栈端到端生产与服务。具备从底层能源管理、算力资源管理、模型推理优化，到Token生产、服务交付及智能运营的全栈端到端服务能力。

items.content:
每年，《麻省理工科技评论》的编辑都会选出 35 名世界顶尖的年轻科学家、企业家和发明家，作为我们最新一届 35 岁以下创新者。从今天开始，我们的 2027 年竞赛正式开放提名。

items.originalContent:
Every year, the editors at MIT Technology Review select 35 of the world’s top young scientists, entrepreneurs, and inventors to honor as our newest class of Innovators Under 35. And starting today, our 2027 competition is officially open for nominations.

We’re on the hunt for researchers and founders who are engineering solutions to some of the most formidable problems society faces, including human disease and climate change. We also recognize those who have made clever and useful inventions, important new scientific discoveries, or technological breakthroughs early in their careers.

We want to hear about people, based anywhere in the world, who are responsible for a major finding or advance and can show real-world impact from their work. To qualify for the list, a nominee must be under the age of 35 as of October 1, 2027 (that is, born on or after October 2, 1992).

Have someone in mind? Or think you’d be a great candidate and want to nominate yourself? Follow this link to suggest someone who you think should make our 2027 list. It’s free and takes only a few minutes. Just be sure to get your nomination in before the deadline—which is 11:59 p.m. Eastern time on Tuesday, January 19.

After the deadline, our editors will review all nominees and select a group of semifinalists, whom we’ll invite to complete a formal application. Then, dozens of expert judges will help us evaluate those applicants and settle on the finalists. You can read more about our selection process here.

Our newsroom began producing our Innovators Under 35 list in 1999. It’s an annual exercise that helps our reporters scout out the brightest young minds in the fields they cover. It also introduces our audience to dozens of rising stars worth watching in the years to come. Subscribers can explore the 2026 list and peruse the full archives.

We look forward to reviewing your nominations.

items.title: 【独立创造】让 Claude Code 重构了一个 1500 多行的函数，测试全过了，但我还是不太放心
items.summary: 最近在做一个 AIGC 项目，有个后台任务函数，调用服务、处理异常、保存结果、发送通知，各种逻辑堆在一起，共 1572 行。 用 Claude Code 分四步重构，最终主函数缩减到 150 行，代码复杂度从 143 降到 7，6471 个测试全部通过，但整个文件反而变长了 31%。 为了验证测试通过是不是业务逻辑也没变，又做了三个事情： 1. 对比实际执行过程 记录了修改前后的数据库操作和日志，发现有几个测试虽然通过，但重构后多执行了一次数据库查询。 2.
paragraphs: 最近在做一个 AIGC 项目，有个后台任务函数，调用服务、处理异常、保存结果、发送通知，各种逻辑堆在一起，共 1572 行。 用 Claude Code 分四步重构，最终主函数缩减到 150 行，代码复杂度从 143 降到 7，6471 个测试全部通过，但整个文件反而变长了 31%。 为了验证测试通过是不是业务逻辑也没变，又做了三个事情： 1. 对比实际执行过程 记录了修改前后的数据库操作和日志，发现有几个测试虽然通过，但重构后多执行了一次数据库查询。 2. 让新旧代码处理相同的任务 模拟服务成功、失败、超时、限流等情况，生成了 12000 个测试场景，对比新旧代码的执行行为，结果全部一致。真实环境有没有差异，还没验证。 3. 故意把代码改坏 故意改错判断条件、边界值，或者少调用一次服务，看看测试能不能发现。最初有些错误没被发现，补充测试后，设置的 63 处行为错误全部被检测出来。 这次最大的感受就是 AI 降低了修改代码的成本，但验证代码是否正确还是非常重要的。就连测试本身，也需要再次进行验证。 这次使用的代码清理流程是开源项目，大家可以看看：https://github.com/rulemason/rulemason 各位大神在用 AI 写代码、改项目的时候，除了人工 Review 和跑测试，还有什么比较有效的验收方法吗？期待分享
当一个项目开始引入 AI 开发的时候，最后基本上必然腐化到 AI 接管一切。

items.title: 【独立创造】23 年裸辞开始钓鱼，现在做了一个没有广告的钓鱼社区小程序：收竿，公开钓点免登录可看，想找钓鱼的 V 友试试
items.summary: 想做的事情很简单：让钓友有个地方记录出钓、交流附近的鱼情，顺便认识一些同城的人。 现在能做什么 晒鱼获、晒装备，和其他钓友交流。 记录自己的出钓。 在同城鱼情留言板聊聊最近的鱼口。 分享钓点，查看公开钓点的位置并导航。 玩一些钓鱼相关的趣味称号。 最近还加了同城「城主」：每城一位，负责管理留言、带动交流，可以置顶、精选、屏蔽留言，也可以建立自己的同城交流群。 产品截图就不放了，放个官网吧： 收竿官网 做了几个取舍 第一，目前没有广告，社区功能免费。
items.content:
想做的事情很简单：让钓友有个地方记录出钓、交流附近的鱼情，顺便认识一些同城的人。

最近还加了同城「城主」：每城一位，负责管理留言、带动交流，可以置顶、精选、屏蔽留言，也可以建立自己的同城交流群。

小程序已经具备开通广告的能力，但我们没有开。对现阶段的收竿来说，先让人用着顺手、愿意回来，比多一个变现入口更重要。

发布者把钓点设为「所有人可见」后，没有登录的人也能查看具体位置、直接导航。只是想看看别人主动分享的位置，不必为了这一步先注册。

钓点有三种可见范围：所有人、互相关注的好友、仅自己。愿意分享给所有人可以，只想和朋友交流，或者留作自己的秘密基地，也可以。

我们也在考虑这个问题。开发和维护都需要投入，社区得能持续做下去。

目前的设想是，等钓友和同城交流积累起来，逐步吸引钓场、周边商家入驻，通过服务商家寻找商业化机会。这是后续想尝试的方向，还不是已经跑通的模式。

社区功能继续免费，接下来很长一段时间，也没有接入广告的打算。

对你来说，记录出钓、找公开钓点、交流同城鱼情，哪个更值得留下来用？

不钓鱼的 V 友，也欢迎从产品体验和社区设计上提意见。

items.title: 【独立变现】Show HN：我恢复了 Palm 的最后一个设备，并将其操作系统带到了其他平台
items.originalTitle: Show HN: I restored Palm's last device, and brought its OS to other platforms
items.summary: 2026 年 11 月 27 日 · Codepoet · 社论（来源：Show HN·独立开发者变现榜）
items.content:
2026 年 11 月 27 日 · Codepoet · 社论

在分享该平台的最新创新成果时，我开始意识到有些人并不真正了解 webOS 是什么。我想我已经忍受了这么久，以至于我从来没有想到世界其他地方已经发生了变化。虽然我本来打算写一篇关于该平台未来的文章，但对于更休闲的探索者来说，也许对过去做一些入门是合适的……

早在 iPhone 出现之前，Palm Pilot 就已经是每个人都想拥有的“it”小玩意了。 Palm 自己的操作系统使这些设备变得有用且响应迅速，但到 2004 年，该公司及其平台都陷入了困境。人们开始努力重新构想两者，并创建了一个全新的“网络操作系统”，以与原始 iPhone 保持同步。

在 Apple 校友 Jon Rubinstein 的领导下，Palm 吸引了一些最优秀的设计师和开发人员（其中许多人甚至来自 Apple），通过利用 Linux、WebKit 和 JavaScript 等开放技术，在有限的硬件上创造流畅、美观的新体验。最初的带有滑出式键盘的 Palm Pre 继而推出了 Pre 2 和 Pixi，当时它们还是 Palm，但团队的英勇努力还不足以与 Google 和 Apple 抗衡。

items.originalContent:
27 November 2026 · by Codepoet · Editorial

In socializing recent innovations for the platform, I began to realize that there are people out there who don’t really know what webOS was. I guess I’ve lived with it so long that it never occurred to me that the rest of the world has moved on. While I had intended to write a post about the future for the platform, maybe a little primer on the past is in order – for the more casual explorer…

Long before the iPhone, the Palm Pilot was the “it” gadget that everyone wanted to have. Palm’s own OS made these devices useful and responsive, but by 2004, both the company and its platform were in a tough place. Efforts began to re-imagine both, and a completely new “web OS” was created to be contemporary of the original iPhone.

Under Apple alum Jon Rubinstein , Palm attracted some of the best designers and developers (many even from Apple), to create a fluid and beautiful new experience on limited hardware, by leveraging open technologies, like Linux, WebKit and JavaScript. The original Palm Pre, with its slide-out keyboard, was followed up by the Pre 2 and Pixi while they were still Palm, but the valiant efforts of the team were not enough to take on Google and Apple. They needed a new owner, with a bigger wallet.

HP decided they wanted to be that owner, and acqui-hired the Palm team . Work resumed on the diminutive Veer slide-out, the impressive Pre3, and the TouchPad tablet line under HP’s brand. The leadership promised webOS everywhere, and it looked like there might be a chance. The TouchPad launched against the iPad, with an updated version of webOS, innovative features that wouldn’t be copied by others for years, and a small but useful App Catalog… and then disaster struck.

HP had a leadership change, and foolishly decided to write off the Palm purchase . The dev team worked quickly to spin off a fully Open Source derivative, Open webOS , and accelerated efforts to make the SDK libraries usable cross-platform. The TouchPad went on fire sale , and most of the Pre3s never made it to market. The little group of innovators who dared to take on the Apple/Google Duopoly were defeated.

LG bought what was left of the commercial OS, and moved quickly to make it the platform for their Smart TVs. Other experiments, including a Smart Watch, only briefly glimpsed daylight. The Palm brand moved to TCL, and HP moved on to selling crappy Android and Windows 8 tablets. It seemed like the end…

But the famously active and dedicated Community weren’t willing to give up. webOS had been defined by Homebrew and the hacker ethos . Community members archived as much of the App Catalog as they could salvage before it was shut off. Open webOS was promptly picked up and became LuneOS – a community re-write that worked on the TouchPad and could be ported to other hardware. The TouchPad itself got some updates through Luna Community Edition, providing launcher features Palm never got to deliver.

Over the ensuing decade, though, the small contributions of the community were not enough to fight back the tide of progress. The ancient Linux kernel, WebKit and OpenSSH stacks became a challenge for the modern web. Previously open APIs that enabled apps and features got closed off as Meta and Google consolidated their iron-fisted control over our screen time. And app devs moved on to more profitable platforms.

In 2018, shortly before the world got shut down by Covid, I started work on restoring the SDK . I liked the fact that my TouchPad and Pre3 couldn’t do much – that meant Google wasn’t tracking my every move. It became a challenge to find a way to proxy, re-route, or update calls so I could keep apps alive, or restore them to functionality.

items.summary: 周四是贾斯汀·汀布莱克 (Justin Timberlake) 与吉米·法伦 (Jimmy Fallon) 在 NBC 今夜秀 (Tonight Show) 上的双重庆祝活动：当然，还有感恩节，您可以在上面的照片中看到这两位老朋友肯定不会忽视感恩节，而对于这位前男孩乐队成员来说，这次访问也是庆祝他的专辑 FutureSex/LoveSounds 20 周年的机会。（来源：Deadline·全球票房与影视工业）
items.content:
周四是贾斯汀·汀布莱克 (Justin Timberlake) 与吉米·法伦 (Jimmy Fallon) 在 NBC 今夜秀 (Tonight Show) 上的双重庆祝活动：当然，还有感恩节，您可以在上面的照片中看到这两位老朋友肯定不会忽视感恩节，而对于这位前男孩乐队成员来说，这次访问也是庆祝他的专辑 FutureSex/LoveSounds 20 周年的机会。

当然，总有新材料可供插入，昨晚，Timberlake 的四部分纪录片系列将于 12 月 11 日开始在 Apple TV 上直播。

感恩节之行以汀布莱克与法伦一起庆祝“派对歌曲的历史”的音乐剧开始。汀布莱克一开始假装不情愿，随后两人开始演唱 Soul II Soul 的《Back to Life (However Do You Want Me)》，然后继续演绎一系列经典舞曲，包括 Ini Kamoze 的《Here Comes the Hotstepper》、Mark Morrison 的《Return of the Mack》、Montell Jordan 的《This Is How We Do》。

汀布莱克还反思了 FutureSex/LoveSounds 专辑的制作，指出在录制这张专辑时，他一直在听“Bowie、David Byrne、Talking Heads、Freddie Mercury、Queen、Billy Idol、James Brown、Eurythmics、INXS……但我们在想，我们如何才能利用舞曲音乐的声音并翻转它？”

items.originalContent:
Thursday was a dual celebration for Justin Timberlake‘s visit with Jimmy Fallon on NBC’s Tonight Show: There was Thanksgiving, of course, which you can see in the photo above was most certainly not ignored by the two old friends, and then for the former boy bander the visit was an opportunity to celebrate the 20th anniversary of his album FutureSex/LoveSounds.

And of course there’s always new material to plug, and last night it was Timberlake‘s four-part doc series streaming on Apple TV beginning December 11.

The Thanksgiving visit began with Timberlake joining Fallon in a musical number celebrating “The History of Party Songs.” With Timberlake initially putting up some mock reluctance, the two then launched into Soul II Soul’s “Back to Life (However Do You Want Me),” then proceeded through a smorgasbord of classic dance hits, including Ini Kamoze’s “Here Comes the Hotstepper,” Mark Morrison’s “Return of the Mack,” Montell Jordan’s “This Is How We Do It,” Spice Girls “Wannabe,” Bell Biv DeVoe’s “Poison,” Timberlake’s own “Rock Your Body,” Wild Cherry’s “Play That Funky Music White Boy,” “Good Times” by Chic, Cool and the Gang’s “Celebration,” and some others you might be able catch before the big finish of The Backstreet Boys’ “I Want It That Way.”

Timberlake also reflected on the making of the FutureSex/LoveSounds album, noting that at the time of its recording he’d been listening to “Bowie, David Byrne, Talking Heads, Freddie Mercury, Queen, Billy Idol, James Brown, Eurythmics, INXS…but we were kind of thinking, How we can take the sonics of dance music and flip it?”

Timberlake recalls that, as presented in the upcoming docuseries, his record label at the time was not initially impressed with the album, thinking it was “too fast,” to which Timberlake responded, “That’s why it’s going to work.” He also remembered that the label was disappointed that he wasn’t using his signature falsetto enough. “I was listening to [David Bowie’s] ‘Rebel Rebel’ a lot…and that music at that time sounded so daring.” Timberlake says he wanted to create the impression that the singer was a character in the song, as Bowie so often did, and the result was “SexyBack.”

Regarding the upcoming four-part Timberlake documentary series, the singer explained that he overcame his initial reluctance – “I’m sort of famously private” – by trusting director and friend Fisher Stevens. “I feel like I’ve gone through a lot in the last five years that made me a better human,” he said.

“But the more we sat down and talked, the more I found myself searching for something that was beneath the surface a little more,” he continued. “And I think that at the end of the day I sort of mustered up some courage to talk about things that I’ve never talked about before. Things that even those that are closest to me don’t know.”

Timberlake also paid tribute to the late singer-songwriter D’Angelo, the major influence who died October 14, 2025. “D’Angelo, for me, he changed everything,” Timberlake told Fallon. “You know, he was one of those artists. Rest in peace. What a brilliant, brilliant, brilliant artist. But I remember when he came out, it just like everything changed. [He] was a once-in-a-generation artist.”

And finally, here’s Timberlake’s performance that capped the Fallon appearance, taking place at New York’s famed Rainbow Room atop 30 Rock. He performs a medley of “FutureSex/LoveSound,” “SexyBack,” “Summer Love” and “My Love.”

The docuseries Timberlake airs on Apple TV on Friday, December 11 with the first two episodes, followed by the third episode on Friday, December 18 and the finale on Wednesday, December 23, 2026.

编辑总监/票房编辑

在今天的船员通话中，我们与近乎 EGOT 冠军的大卫·伯恩 (David Byrne) 聊了聊他为亚历克斯·吉布尼 (Alex Gibney) 备受争议的纪录片《马斯克》创作的新歌《让我卖给你一个梦想》(Let Me Sell You A Dream)，是的，关于埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk)。

伯恩向我们讲述了他在最新巡演“谁是天空？”欧洲站期间共同创作这首小曲的经历。他还骑自行车去伦敦一家音乐设备店购买录音设备，这样他就可以在酒店房间里搭建一个临时录音室，为奥斯卡提名作曲家丹尼尔·彭伯顿（这首歌的共同创作者）录制曲目。

在录制这首曲子时，伯恩惊呼道：“我会坐在酒店房间的小麦克风支架前，进入埃隆·马斯克的角色（呼气），然后开始咆哮。”

Editorial Director/Box Office Editor

On today’s Crew Call we chat with near EGOT winner David Byrne about “Let Me Sell You A Dream,” his new song for Alex Gibney’s controversial documentary Musk about, yes, Elon Musk.

Byrne tells us about co-writing the ditty during the European leg of his latest tour “Who is the Sky?” and biking to a London musical equipment shop to get recording gear, so he could create a makeshift studio in his hotel room and lay down tracks for Oscar nominated composer Daniel Pemberton, who is a co-writer on the song.

In recording the tune, Byrne exclaims, “I’d sit at my little mic stand in a hotel room and I’d go into character as Elon Musk (exhale), and just start ranting.”

Off the bat, “Let Me Sell You a Dream” in its fast dance tempo brings to mind the 1986 Talking Heads single “Wild Wild Life” which Byrne wrote for the Warner Bros absurdist reality movie he directed and co-wrote, True Stories.

Byrne says that “Let Me Sell You a Dream” had to be “hard hitting…It’s going to have an impact at the at the end. It has to jump right in, and grab you by the throat.”

“It’s not one of those fading-while-the-credits roll and everybody decides, ‘I’m going to get up, get out and get back to my car before everybody else.'”

“Let Me Sell You a Dream” is also throwback to the types of pseudo anti-yuppie tunes that Talking Heads was known for including 1988’s “(Nothing) But Flowers” and 1979’s “Life During Wartime”. Byrne explains that the Musk end-credits song was arguably the “fastest” he has ever written in his career. To date, while Musk has railed against Gibney about the documentary, he hasn’t sent any praise or tomatoes to the Oscar winning Byrne. Give a listen to Byrne’s process here:

Byrne also takes us down memory regaling that his first instrument was a violin, and how he grew up inspired by The Rolling Stones and Motown. He also chats about the early days of the Talking Heads when they were discovered by Sire Records’ boss Seymour Stein (“He could meet with us, talk with us and and sing ours songs back to us”) as well as working with Bernardo Bertolucci and producer Jeremy Thomas on the score for The Last Emperor which won Byrne an original score Oscar which he co-shared with Cong Su and Ryūichi Sakamoto.

A time when Byrne was told by the music industry he was too audacious? How about when he did his first solo album in 1989, the Latino infused “Rei Momo”?

资深国际电影记者

中国导演邹晶的《无名女孩》在多哈电影节上荣获 75,000 美元最佳叙事奖，第二届改版影片于周五晚上落下帷幕。

这部以中国为背景的第一部故事片讲述了一个年轻女孩的命运，她在婴儿时期就被遗弃在垃圾桶里，然后在三组不同的监护人和环境下从婴儿期成长到青春期。

该片于今年早些时候在戛纳影评人周全球首映，并获得了费比西奖。格林威治娱乐公司 (Greenwich Entertainment) 为美国购买了该影片，并计划于 2027 年初进行巡演并发行。

Senior International Film Correspondent

Chinese director Zou Jing’s A Girl Unknown won the top $75,000 Best Narrative prize at the Doha Film Festival as the second edition of its revamped format came to a close on Friday evening.

The China-set first feature follows the fate of a young girl who is found abandoned as a baby in a rubbish bin and then grows up from babyhood through to adolescence with three sets of different guardians and circumstances.

The film world premiered in Cannes Critics’ Week earlier this year where it won the Fipresci Prize. The picture was acquired for the U.S. by Greenwich Entertainment which is planning an early 2027 tour and release.

Rafael Manuel won Best Artistic Achievement in Narrative for Filipiñana about a 17-year-old girl who discovers a rotten side to the posh countryclub where she works on the golf course. The film world premiered in Sundance, where it won the World Cinema Special Jury Award. The film is the Philippines’ entry for the 99th Academy Awards.

Best Actress was awarded posthumously to Josette Kwanya for her performance in her son Auguste Bernard Kouemo’s House of the Wind as an elderly Cameroonian woman waiting for her children to return home after they left for Europe in search of fresh life opportunities.

The film won Venice’s Lion of the Future for a Debut Film when it premiered there in its Orizzonti sidebar in September.

This year’s jury was presided over by Japanese director Naomi Kawase, who was joined by by Oscar-winning documentarian Gianfranco Rosi, rising actor Adam Bessa, Tunisian producer Dora Bouchoucha and Palestinian director Kamal Aljafari.

In further prizes, Best Documentary went to Asmahan Bkerat’s Concrete Land about a Bedouin family struggling to preserve their traditional way of life in tents, as well as the Fipresci prize, which is being awarded at the festival for the first time this year.

In other documentary prizes, Tala Hadid’s Bardi won the Best Artistic Achievement for Documentary.

items.content:
漫威老将塞巴斯蒂安·斯坦仍然坚持去年的《雷霆万钧》，尽管它是漫威电影宇宙票房最低的电影之一。

在这部合作电影中，他再次扮演巴基·巴恩斯（又名冬日战士），与弗洛伦斯·皮尤饰演叶莲娜·贝洛娃和大卫·哈伯饰演红色卫士一起组建了漫威宇宙中的新团体“雷电”。后来他们更名为新复仇者联盟，由怀亚特·拉塞尔饰演美国特工、刘易斯·普尔曼饰演哨兵、汉娜·约翰·卡门饰演幽灵，该团队将在下个月的《复仇者联盟：世界末日》中回归。

《霹雳娇娃》于 2025 年 5 月上映后，全球票房收入为 3.82 亿美元，在所有 38 部 MCU 电影中排名第五。排在其后面的电影是《黑寡妇》（3.79 亿美元）、《美国队长：复仇者先锋》（3.7 亿美元）、《无敌浩克》（2.64 亿美元）和《漫威》（2.06 亿美元）。它们与今年夏天的《蜘蛛侠：崭新的一天》相去甚远，后者是漫威宇宙第二大电影。

“我认为，当你有了一个工作室，有了漫威，这么多年了，他们刚刚把它从公园里拿出来，全球 3.5 亿美元，类似的东西，突然间就显得没那么多了，”斯坦在《下一个最佳影片》中说道。 “但那是多少钱，太疯狂了。”

Marvel veteran Sebastian Stan is sticking up for last year’s “Thunderbolts,” despite it being one of the lowest-grossing MCU movies.

In the team-up movie, he reprised his role as Bucky Barnes, aka the Winter Soldier, alongside Florence Pugh as Yelena Belova and David Harbour as the Red Guardian to form the Thunderbolts, a new group in the MCU. They later renamed themselves the New Avengers, made up of Wyatt Russell as U.S. Agent, Lewis Pullman as Sentry and Hannah John-Kamen as Ghost, and the team will return in next month’s “Avengers: Doomsday.”

After releasing in May 2025, “Thunderbolts” ended its box office run with $382 million worldwide, ranking as the fifth lowest total out of all 38 MCU films. The only movies below it are “Black Widow” ($379 million), “Captain America: The First Avenger” ($370 million), “The Incredible Hulk” ($264 million) and “The Marvels” ($206 million). They’re all a far cry from this summer’s “Spider-Man: Brand New Day,” which is the second biggest MCU movie with $2.5 billion (behind the highest-grossing film ever, “Avengers: Endgame” with $2.94 billion).

“I think it’s just when you’ve had a studio and you’ve had Marvel and it’s been so many years where they’ve just been knocking it out of the park, $350 million global, something like that, it just suddenly doesn’t seem that much,” Stan said on “Next Best Picture.” “But it’s insane how much money that is.”

He added, “For us, it felt like a success. I know a lot of care went into that and it had more nuance to it in terms of some of the recent ones, from my point of view at least, dealing with real issues like mental health and depression and so on.”

“Thunderbolts” was praised by fans and critics for its darker tone and how it elevated its cast of misfit, lesser-known characters. Its director, Jake Schreier, was tapped by Marvel to helm its 2028 “X-Men” movie, with a cast including Sadie Sink, Adam Driver, Inde Navarrette, Kit Connor and more.

items.content:
凭借《玛莲娜》和《不可逆转》在国际上崭露头角的迷人意大利明星莫妮卡·贝鲁奇在 50 岁时，成为在萨姆·门德斯执导的《007：幽灵党》中扮演邦德女郎的最年长女性，创造了詹姆斯·邦德的历史。

但这部电影并没有标志着她作为好莱坞性感象征的职业生涯的暮年，反而为贝鲁奇开启了新的篇章，贝鲁奇的职业生涯近年来一直在重获新生。

在马拉喀什电影节上由 Variety 主​​持的一次坦诚、内容广泛的大师班上，贝鲁奇回忆道，门德斯确实“想展现一个成熟的女性，我认为这是一个美丽的主意。” “他告诉我，‘听着，我有一个强大而不寻常的角色，这将会令人惊讶，有点革命性，’她说。 “我当时 50 岁了，我从来没有见过 50 岁的邦德女性。所以我想我是我们见过的最年长的詹姆斯·邦德女性，无论是女士还是女孩。

最终，《007：幽灵党》和埃米尔·库斯图里卡的《银河之路》（她与这位塞尔维亚电影制片人演对手戏）迎来了她人生的关键时刻。

Monica Bellucci, the glamorous Italian star who broke through internationally with “Malena” and “Irreversible,” was 50 when she made James Bond history as the oldest woman to play a Bond girl in Sam Mendes’ “Spectre.”

But rather than marking the twilight of her career as a Hollywood sex symbol, the movie ushered in a new chapter for Bellucci whose career has been enjoying a second wind in recent years.

During a candid, wide-ranging masterclass moderated by Variety at the Marrakech Film Festival, Bellucci recalled that Mendes really “wanted to show a mature woman, and I thought it was a beautiful idea.” “He told me, ‘Listen, I have a strong and unusual role that’s going to be surprising, a little revolutionary,” she said. “I was 50, and I had never seen a 50-year-old Bond woman. So I think I’m the oldest James Bond woman, lady or girl that we’ve ever seen,” Bellucci said with a laugh in front of a huge crowd of locals and film students who queued for over two hours to get in.

Ultimately, “Spectre” and Emir Kusturica’s “On the Milky Road,” in which she starred opposite the Serbian filmmaker, came at a pivotal moment in her life.

“Suddenly, I had two very strong roles. Those two films helped me get through the transition of turning 50, which wasn’t easy for an actress,” she said.

Bellucci, whose body of work has largely been shaped by celebrated male auteurs — from Francis Ford Coppola to Giuseppe Tornatore, Gaspar Noé and David Lynch — also noted that she has enjoyed working with more female directors in recent years. She cited Alice Rohrwacher with her Cannes-prizewinning “The Wonders,” Rebecca Miller with “The Private Lives of Pippa Lee,” Kaouther Ben Hania with “The Man Who Sold His Skin” and Léa Mysius’ “Birthday Girl,” which competed at this year’s Cannes.

“When I was younger, there weren’t as many female directors as there are today. It’s new to have so many female directors, screenwriters and even technicians on a set, so many women. We’re witnessing something completely new,” she said.

“It’s another way of telling stories, sometimes another vision. And between women, sometimes there’s this ‘je ne sais quoi,’ as we say in France. Suddenly, we look at each other and, without words, we express ourselves and we understand each other. So I also really like working with women whenever possible.”

Bellucci said the roles she is being offered have also evolved as she’s gotten older, allowing her to explore facets of herself that she couldn’t have accessed earlier in her career.

“Our body is our working instrument. So the instrument changes and, consequently, the roles change. It’s another part of ourselves that’s expressing itself,” she said. “As we get older, we also gain experience, and we have another way of telling the story of life.”
